LanguageData.UBFC_Set_Relink_Label: Relink existing furniture on map load
LanguageData.UBFC_Set_Relink_Tip: When enabled, dressers, screens and other furniture that were already built in an old save get relinked on the first tick after the map loads, so they take effect immediately without being rebuilt. This is a one-time cost and is skipped afterwards.
LanguageData.UBFC_Set_Verbose_Tip: Prints scan statistics, injection details and relink timing to the log, and lists the detected facilities and beds in the report below. Useful when investigating why a specific piece of furniture does not affect a specific bed.
LanguageData.UBFC_Set_Aggressive_Label: Aggressive mode (treat every facility as bed furniture)
LanguageData.UBFC_Set_Aggressive_Tip: Off by default. While off, only furniture that can be confirmed as bed furniture is processed: it either already links to at least one bed, or it carries a bed-specific placement constraint. When on, every def with CompProperties_Facility participates in bed linking — useful for furniture whose author forgot to attach it to any bed, leaving it completely inert.\nClick "Rescan now" below to apply immediately.
LanguageData.UBFC_Set_LinkLimit_Tip: Off by default. Vanilla allows only one facility of the same kind to affect a given building (the "max simultaneous connections" line in the furniture's info panel). When on, that cap is lifted and a single bed can benefit from several identical facilities at once.\nThis noticeably changes game balance — enable at your own discretion. Click "Rescan now" below to apply.
LanguageData.UBFC_Set_MaxDistance_Tip: On by default. Some furniture has its max link distance written as a value smaller than one cell (GloomyFurniture's teddy bear uses 0.9). Since the minimum spacing between cells is 1, such a value is mechanically identical to "must occupy the same cell as the bed", so placing it next to a bed can never link. When on, those distances are raised to 2 cells so an adjacent bed works.\nOnly facilities whose value falls inside (0, 1) are touched; any other distance is left alone. Click "Rescan now" below to apply.
